name: Inma Daitoshi Beast City - Vampire Madonna Hen
original_name: 淫魔大都市 BEAST CITY 【ヴァンパイアマドンナ編】
source:
Year 201X, Tokyo underground world. At midnight in the secret club turn girls into toys with you own hands.

Fandisc, repackaging of the pictures and videos from the animation into a game.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
201X年，东京地下世界。午夜在秘密俱乐部，亲手把女孩变成玩具。

Fandisc，将动画中的图片和视频重新打包成游戏。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
